page.title: Storyboard Shot Card UI Redesign · 5 Layouts
page.subtitle: Each shot is an independent card on the canvas, keeping the real card's header, status, scene meta and the Expand / Generate image (billing) actions. The only text detail under a shot is the final image prompt, with the image slot as the core.

fields.promptOnlyNote: Cards keep the header index, status, scene and the Expand / Generate image billing actions, but the body shows only the image and the final image prompt — no duration, characters, or description clutter.

vertical.title: Layout 1 · Prompt card: bordered base (final)
vertical.description: Shared structure everywhere: image placeholder → chips → final image prompt → generate. The prompt card is a bordered gray box with a rule under the label.

landscape.title: Layout 2 · Prompt card: top accent line
landscape.description: Same structure; only the prompt card is reskinned — white bordered box with a tone-colored top line and an inline label, no divider.

poster.title: Layout 3 · Prompt card: dashed border + dots
poster.description: Same structure; the prompt card becomes a dashed border with a faint dotted pattern and a dashed divider — a draft-annotation feel.

editorial.title: Layout 4 · Prompt card: left accent bar
editorial.description: Same structure; the prompt card drops the outer border for a left accent bar and a thin rule under the label — restrained and clean.

datasheet.title: Layout 5 · Prompt card: accent header strip
datasheet.description: Same structure; the prompt card uses a solid accent header strip over a white body — a panel look with clear hierarchy.

0.prompt: 16:9 cinematic storyboard frame, a retro low-poly bedroom lit by a faint yellow vanity lamp. Ella, in a white low-poly nightgown, slowly combs her long black hair built from coarse polygons while her mirror reflection mirrors every motion. Low-saturation warm/cool contrast, quiet yet faintly uneasy mood.

1.prompt: 16:9 cinematic close-up storyboard frame. Ella's right hand finishes a final combing motion and gently sets the wooden comb on the vanity. The reflection traces the exact same path, shallow depth of field blurring the background to keep only the comb and hand crisp, emphasizing the mechanical stillness of the moment.

2.prompt: 16:9 cinematic storyboard frame. The real Ella's hands have fully left the comb and gone still. Yet the reflection, half a second behind reality, lowers the mirrored comb in a stiff, frame-dropping motion. Composition stresses the desync between reality and reflection, cool palette, mounting dread.

3.prompt: 16:9 cinematic storyboard frame. The real Ella's body is completely frozen, face pale as a pixel texture. The reflection's eyes widen in terror, locked dead-ahead on the mirror and staring at the viewer. The low-poly facial angles look uncanny in the dim light, symmetric centered framing pushing the mood to its peak.
